info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Legal Entity Directory Management API
info.description: The Legal Entity Directory Management API enables businesses to update and manage legal entity information efficiently. This API supports operations that allow users to modify attributes associated with various legal entities, ensuring that data remains accurate and current. Typical consumers include financial institutions, regulatory bodies, and compliance teams who require up-to-date details for reporting and operational purposes. Utilize this API to maintain the integrity of legal entity records in your banking systems.

put.description: This operation allows you to update the details of a specific legal entity entry in the directory using its unique resource identifier. Ensure that the provided data adheres to the required structure for successful updates.

requestBody.description: Updates the details of a specific legal entity in the directory. Ensure that all required fields are included and properly formatted as per the schema.

200.description: The request was successful and the entity was updated.
